# K+A Consulting

> K+A Consulting LLC is an independent investment advisory boutique based in Tbilisi, Georgia (registration no. 402235684). It helps family offices, HNW and UHNW investors, and companies get access to capital and markets in Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan and Kazakhstan (the Caucasus and Central Asia).

## Key facts

- Services: private debt and equity, commodity trade finance and bank credit lines, market entry and exit, company registration, bank accounts and payment routes, licensing and regulatory work, real estate advisory, residence permits.
- Markets: Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan; deals along the Middle Corridor (Trans-Caspian route).
- Clients: single and multi-family offices, HNWI and UHNWI, sovereign and institutional investors, banks and trade financiers, mid-sized commodity traders, companies entering the region.
- Terms: retainer plus success fee; most mandates from USD 500k. Client money never passes through K+A accounts (bank or notary escrow only).
- Process: first call, NDA, signed mandate, execution and closing. KYC/AML checks apply to every engagement.
- Languages: English, Georgian, Russian, French.
- Selected mandates (anonymised): acquisition of an 80-room hotel in Tbilisi; EUR 15m UK/EU debt refinancing for a UHNWI from Kazakhstan; USD 4m bank credit line for a commodity trader operating from Armenia and Dubai; USD 1.5m raised from an EU investor for serviced apartments in Tbilisi; prime real estate deals in Armenia and Azerbaijan.
- Contact: at@kaconsulting.ge, +995 598 896 040 (phone, WhatsApp, Telegram). Office: Tbilisi, Georgia.
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/kaconsulting

## Services

- [Bank account in Georgia](https://kaconsulting.ge/services/bank-account-georgia/): opening corporate and personal accounts in Georgia for non-residents.
- [Company registration in Georgia](https://kaconsulting.ge/services/company-registration-georgia/): setting up an LLC in Georgia, tax regimes and timelines.
- [Commodity trade finance](https://kaconsulting.ge/services/trade-finance/): pre-export finance, bank credit lines and letters of credit for traders in the region.
- [Private debt and equity](https://kaconsulting.ge/services/private-debt-equity/): raising and structuring debt and equity for projects and companies.
- [Real estate in Georgia](https://kaconsulting.ge/services/real-estate-georgia/): sourcing, due diligence and structuring of real estate investments.
- [Residence permit in Georgia](https://kaconsulting.ge/services/residence-permit-georgia/): residence through investment in property and other routes.
- [Virtual Zone IT company](https://kaconsulting.ge/services/virtual-zone-georgia/): Georgia's Virtual Zone status for IT companies.
- [Bank account in Armenia](https://kaconsulting.ge/services/bank-account-armenia/): accounts in Armenia for foreign companies and individuals.
- [AIFC company in Kazakhstan](https://kaconsulting.ge/services/aifc-company-kazakhstan/): companies in the Astana International Financial Centre.
